title: ZelTF
wikitext:
{{wrongtitle|title=zelTF}} zelTF is a free, stand-alone package for the original ''[[QuakeWorld]]'' ''[[Team Fortress]]''. It was designed to overcome the difficulties new users had in installing and configuring the game. It includes everything required to play the game with all of the latest graphical updates. == Features == Bundled into installer
''[[ezQuake]]'' 1.9 alpha (zelTF build)
Documentation and guide
Maps including textures, lighting and loc files
Status bar always on and positioned correctly above hud
Team Fortress scoreboard
High resolution gfx and models
Teamplay communication binds
Advanced and easily edited configs and key bindings
High quality sound effects
Grenade script
Auto id script
